title: Start May With One Outcome You Can Verify
teaser: A long list of intentions can make the most important result difficult to see.
message: Write one observable result you want by the end of May and place it where you review your work.

title: Give One Active Folder a Naming Standard
teaser: Inconsistent filenames make search handoff and version checks slower than necessary.
message: Define a simple filename order for one active folder using fields such as date topic and version.

title: Review Recovery Codes for One Important Account
teaser: Two-factor authentication is less useful if the recovery path is unavailable when a device is lost.
message: Check that recovery codes for one important account exist and are stored in a secure accessible place.

title: Write a Stop Condition Before More Work
teaser: Past effort can make it harder to abandon an option that no longer deserves resources.
message: For one active initiative record the measurable condition that would make you stop pause or change direction.

title: Identify One Repetitive Task Worth Automating
teaser: Small manual steps become expensive when they repeat across many days.
message: Choose one task you repeated several times this week and separate the steps that could be automated safely.

title: Compare Total Cost Instead of Purchase Price
teaser: The cheapest starting price can become expensive after fees maintenance or required extras.
message: For one purchase decision list the initial price and the likely additional costs over its useful period.

title: Check the Effective Date of One Rule
teaser: A policy or instruction can be accurate for an earlier period and still be wrong today.
message: Before relying on one important rule confirm its effective date and whether a newer version exists.

title: Reduce One Delayed Task to a Five-Minute Start
teaser: Unclear beginnings often create more resistance than the work itself.
message: Define the first action you can complete in five minutes on one delayed task and do only that start.

title: Turn a Meeting Topic Into a Decision Question
teaser: A topic can generate discussion without making clear what outcome the meeting needs.
message: Rewrite one agenda item as a specific question that the group should answer before the meeting ends.

title: Verify a Backup's Source and Timestamp
teaser: A backup artifact is hard to trust when you cannot tell what system and moment it represents.
message: Inspect one backup and confirm both the source system and creation time before treating it as recoverable evidence.

title: Test a Form With Missing Required Data
teaser: A form that works only on the happy path may fail users when information is incomplete.
message: Submit or test one form with a required field missing and check whether the recovery guidance is clear.

title: Question One Stored Personal Data Field
teaser: Data that no longer supports a purpose still creates exposure and maintenance obligations.
message: Choose one personal data field you retain and document the current reason for keeping it or plan its removal.

title: Choose an Early Warning Signal for One Risk
teaser: A useful risk indicator appears before the final failure rather than after it.
message: For one open risk define one observable sign that would tell you conditions are getting worse.

title: Explain One New Idea Without the Source Open
teaser: Restating information from memory exposes gaps that copying can conceal.
message: Close your reference and explain one thing you learned today in two short sentences using your own wording.

title: Review the First Half of May With One Ratio
teaser: A general sense of progress can hide a meaningful difference between plan and result.
message: For one May target compare the amount completed so far with the amount you expected by midmonth.

title: Name One Accountable Owner for an Outcome
teaser: Shared participation does not always create clear accountability for the final result.
message: For one active deliverable record the single person or role responsible for confirming completion.

title: Remove One Low-Value Notification
teaser: Frequent low-priority alerts train attention to react even when nothing important happened.
message: Disable one notification category that rarely leads to a useful action.

title: Add Provenance to One Important Number
teaser: A figure is difficult to audit when its source cannot be traced later.
message: Attach a source file system or query reference to one important number in a report or note.

title: Set a Review Before One Automatic Renewal
teaser: Renewal dates can pass before the cost receives deliberate attention.
message: Create a reminder before one recurring subscription renews so you can evaluate use and price first.

title: Remove One Unnecessary Mobile Permission
teaser: Old permissions can remain enabled after the feature that needed them is no longer used.
message: Review one app's access to location camera or microphone and revoke any permission it does not currently need.

title: Define the Exit Condition of One Process
teaser: A process can continue indefinitely when completion is described only as keep working.
message: Write one verifiable condition that means a repeated process has finished successfully.

title: Find Two Parts of a Project That Can Move Independently
teaser: Unnecessary sequencing can make one blocked step delay unrelated work.
message: Take one larger project and identify at least two pieces that can progress without waiting for each other.

title: Put the Requested Action Near the Top
teaser: Recipients can miss the required response when it is buried beneath context.
message: In one important message state the action decision or deadline you need before adding secondary detail.

title: Exercise One Negative Test Case
teaser: A successful path does not prove that invalid input is rejected safely.
message: Use one deliberately invalid input in an important workflow and confirm the system fails in the expected way.

title: Give One Temporary Decision an Expiration Trigger
teaser: Temporary choices often become permanent when nobody schedules reconsideration.
message: Record a date event or threshold that will force one provisional decision to be reviewed again.

title: Measure One Delay Instead of Estimating It
teaser: Perceived slowness can point to the wrong bottleneck when no timing data exists.
message: Time one frequently used operation from start to usable result and save the measurement for comparison.

title: Navigate One Core Flow With the Keyboard
teaser: Mouse access alone does not show whether an interface supports keyboard users.
message: Use only the keyboard to reach and activate the main controls in one web or desktop workflow.

title: Check Retention Before Deleting an Old Record
teaser: Cleanup can create a new problem if information that must be retained is removed too early.
message: Before deleting one old file confirm whether any legal operational or recovery requirement still applies.

title: Choose May Work That Deserves to Roll Forward
teaser: Automatic rollover fills the next month with commitments that may no longer matter.
message: Classify remaining May work as cancel defer or commit to June instead of carrying everything forward.

title: Challenge One Metric With the Outcome It Represents
teaser: Easy-to-count activity can become a poor proxy for actual value.
message: Choose one metric you track and explain in one sentence how it connects to the result you really care about.

title: Close May With One Repeatable Improvement
teaser: A small operating rule can preserve a lesson longer than a one-time burst of effort.
message: Turn one lesson from May into a checklist item default rule or recurring review you can use again.
